title: Precision on paper
hook: Two stated cases: explore the realized coverage of a stated interval procedure.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the realized coverage of a stated interval procedure affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Misses, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the realized coverage of a stated interval procedure in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
